$comment: Level 12 (pacing pass): Forge mode on a 160 map. After the Forge the turtle rival (normal, 14 troops, towers, posted guards) sits behind its moat. Wolf dens haunt the central plain; clearing them raises the middle ward (prayer chain), holding all three stones raises a seer stone on the north hill that the digger can reach as easily. Staged: clear two dens, hold three stones 60 s, win the hill seer stone, raze the rival Hearth, then grow to 70.
name: The Forge
description: Before the battle, both tribes reshape the land around their Hearths. Raise walls or dig a moat, then press Ready. Clear two wolf dens, hold three stones, win the hill seer stone, cross the careful digger's moat and raze its Hearth, then grow to 70 followers.

rewards.text: The home ley pays mana while you hold it.
The home ward guards your southern flank.
The middle ward commands the road to the moat.
The hill seer stone looks over the digger's moat.

objectives.text: Pray at the risen middle ward and hold all three stones at once for a minute
Win the seer stone risen on the north hill
Cross the moat and raze the digger's Hearth

do.text: The Forge is over. Flatten or Raise Land can bridge a moat. Wolves hold the central plain.
The digger sends a war band across the plain.
With the wolves gone, the middle ward rises on the plain. The digger wants it too.
A seer stone rises on the north hill, as near the digger as it is to you.
